title: The chef who can’t eat what she cooks – B2 English Listening Test

seo.title: The chef who can’t eat what she cooks – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Improve your listening skills with our B2 pre-advanced listening practice test on food and allergies. Transcription is included!

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Watch a video about a chef who suffers from food allergies, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.
For more videos like this, go to Great Big Story
Questions

choices.html: that was her plan since she was growing up
she needed to do something about her allergies
has many allergies, but none is very serious.
has fewer meals than usual to avoid health problems.
her respirator is not very uncomfortable and makes her look cool.
not wearing her respirator could even cause her death.
plans to buy a piece of land somewhere and live there.
learned how to cook for restricted diets on an online platform.
vegans are more concerned about not using allergens when cooking.
she can make anyone enjoy food without using common allergens.

questions.prompt: What was special about Kathlena's "candy overload cake"?

choices.html: It was for a girl who could not have birthday cakes due to her preferences.
It included every possible type of candy and sweet treat on top
It was the first birthday cake for a 12-year-old girl.
